yt.title: Up to {c_pct}% of a QR code can be damaged #Shorts
yt.description:
QR codes use Reed–Solomon error correction; level H recovers up to ~30% of codewords. Version 40 holds up to 7,089 digits.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.text: A QR code still works with 30% torn off
scenes.narration: You can damage up to thirty percent of a QR code, and it still scans.
It stores extra error correction data. At the highest level, it can rebuild about thirty percent. That's how logos fit in the middle.

scenes.label: digits
scenes.narration: The biggest one holds seven thousand eighty nine digits.

scenes.text: Same math as CDs and space probes
scenes.narration: The same math protects CDs and space probe signals.
